title: Coco Ichibanya Owner Considering Sale
paragraphs: CoCo Ichibanya is the world's largest curry restaurant chain, with more than 1,500 restaurants around the world.

It's known for Japanese curry served over rice, with customers choosing toppings such as pork cutlets, cheese and vegetables. While most of its stores are in Japan, the chain also has restaurants in the US, the UK and India.
But CoCo Ichibanya could soon have a new owner.
Japanese food manufacturer House Foods Group owns 51% of Ichibanya, the company behind CoCo Ichibanya. And it was recently reported by Japanese news outlets that it's considering selling its stake.
The possible sale comes as higher costs for food and other supplies are making business more difficult for the company.
However, nothing has been decided yet, and House Foods Group issued a statement saying it's considering a number of options for Ichibanya's future.

House Foods Group has had a relationship with Ichibanya since long before it owned the company. In fact, House Foods Group has been supplying Ichibanya with curry roux — the mixture of flour and butter that forms the base for its curry sauce — ever since the curry chain was founded in 1978.

Over the years, the relationship between the two companies slowly became closer. House Foods Group first bought shares in Ichibanya in 1998. Then, in 2015, it spent about 30 billion yen — or $250 million at the time — to increase its stake from 19.5% to 51%. This gave House Foods Group control of the company.
Since then, the two companies have worked together to buy supplies and grow their businesses outside Japan.
For now, House Foods Group hasn't decided whether to sell its stake in Ichibanya. But after seeing many changes over nearly 50 years together, their relationship could soon change again.
